units.source_text: 我点上了自己房里的油灯，然后不时地看表。

en.t: I lit the lamp in my room, and then kept looking at my watch from time to time.

units.source_text: 我感觉再没有比那时走得更缓慢的表了。

en.t: I felt that no watch had ever moved more slowly than it did then.

units.source_text: 虽然记不清自己醒来的时间，但可以肯定天快要亮了。

en.t: I could not clearly remember what time I had woken, but I was sure dawn was near.

units.source_text: 我一边转圈，一边焦急地等着天亮，恍惚觉得自己身处永无尽头的漫漫长夜。

en.t: As I paced around, I waited anxiously for dawn, dazed by the feeling that I was trapped in an endless, long night.
